speaker: Sera
source_en: Stay behind me. The fog is thicker here.
translation_ko: 제 뒤에 계세요. 여긴 안개가 더 짙습니다.

speaker: Pip
source_en: My bell fell into the well.

speaker: Kael
source_en: You really kicked the hornet's nest.

speaker: Juno
source_en: Amazing. We broke the unbreakable thing.
translation_ko: 놀랍네. 절대 안 망가진다는 걸 우리가 망가뜨렸어.

speaker: Marrow
source_en: I would step aside while I am still asking.
translation_ko: 제가 아직 부탁으로 말할 때 비켜서시죠.

speaker: System
source_en: A lantern that burns with yesterday's rain.

speaker: Oracle
source_en: Stars do not answer names spoken in fear.
translation_ko: 별은 두려움 속에 불린 이름에 답하지 않느니라.

speaker: System
source_en: A cloak stitched from the hush before thunder.

speaker: Juno
source_en: Guess that slime lost its grip.

speaker: Kael
source_en: The elevator has more patience than you.

speaker: Sera
source_en: Not exactly a winning hand, but we can play it.
translation_ko: 이길 패는 아니지만, 그래도 해볼 수는 있습니다.

speaker: Narrator
source_en: A hooded guest lowered their voice.

speaker: Oracle
source_en: When the pale gate opens, every debt learns to speak.
translation_ko: 창백한 문이 열리면, 모든 빚이 말을 배우리라.
